versions.content: If development error detection is enabled for the OCU driver : If the parameter ChannelNumber is invalid (not within the range specified by the configuration), the function Ocu_GetCounter shall raise the error OCU_E_PARAM_INVALID_CHANNEL and shall return the value “ 0 ”.
